analysis.summaryJa: このページは、現在完了の継続で for を期間の長さ、since を開始点として使い分けることを定規と旗の図で示し、過去の出来事が「だから今」という現在の結果を生む用法まで一つの時間線で結んでいる。
grammarPoints: for＋期間で継続の長さを示す
since＋起点で継続が始まった時を示す
ago は今から過去へ数えるため通常は単純過去と使う
現在完了の結果用法は過去の原因と現在の状況を結ぶ
状態動詞の継続では現在完了単純形を使う
visualEvidence: FOR の定規が期間の長さを測っている
SINCE の旗が時間線上の開始点を示している
過去の原因からNOWへ伸びる矢印が現在の結果を表している
鍵・凍結道路などの結果図が今困っている理由を示している
commonTraps: for の後ろに年号などの起点を置く
since の後ろに three years など期間の長さを置く
three years ago を現在完了と直接組み合わせる
現在の結果が重要なのに終了した過去だけを表す形を選ぶ
has／have の後ろに過去分詞を置かない

questions.prompt: The customer service center has operated around the clock ------- six months.

choices.C: for

questions.translationJa: 顧客サービスセンターは6か月間、24時間体制で稼働しています。
questions.explanationJa: six months は期間の長さなので for を使います。

questions.prompt: Ms. Wong has worked in procurement ------- April.

choices.C: ago

questions.translationJa: ウォンさんは4月から調達部で働いています。
questions.explanationJa: April は継続の開始点なので since が適切です。

questions.prompt: Our company has occupied this office ------- more than a decade.

choices.C: at

questions.translationJa: 当社は10年以上この事務所を使用しています。
questions.explanationJa: more than a decade は期間を表すため for を置きます。

questions.prompt: The loading dock has been closed ------- the inspection began.

choices.C: ago

questions.translationJa: 荷積み場は点検が始まって以来閉鎖されています。
questions.explanationJa: the inspection began は開始時点を示す節なので since を使います。

questions.prompt: I ------- my access card two hours ago, so security issued a temporary one.

choices.C: have been losing

questions.translationJa: 私は2時間前に入館カードをなくしたので、警備担当が仮カードを発行しました。
questions.explanationJa: two hours ago は完結した過去を示すため単純過去 lost を使います。

questions.prompt: The storm has damaged the phone lines, so the branch ------- unreachable now.

choices.C: is

questions.translationJa: 嵐で電話線が損傷したため、その支店は今連絡が取れません。
questions.explanationJa: 現在の結果を述べるので now に対応する現在形 is が必要です。
questions.focus: 現在完了の原因と現在結果

questions.prompt: We have used the same courier ------- 2022.

choices.C: ago

questions.translationJa: 私たちは2022年から同じ宅配業者を利用しています。
questions.explanationJa: 2022 は起点なので since を選びます。

questions.prompt: The conference room has been unavailable ------- three days.

choices.C: from

questions.translationJa: その会議室は3日間利用できない状態です。
questions.explanationJa: three days は長さなので for が適切です。

questions.prompt: The technician has fixed the printer, so employees can use it -------.

choices.C: now

questions.translationJa: 技術者がプリンターを直したので、従業員は今使えます。
questions.explanationJa: 修理という過去の原因から生じる現在の結果を示すため now が合います。

questions.prompt: The road has remained icy ------- early this morning.

choices.C: ago

questions.translationJa: 道路は今朝早くから凍結したままです。
questions.explanationJa: early this morning は状態開始の起点なので since を使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence using a duration expression.

choices.A: The help desk has been busy since two hours.
choices.B: The help desk has been busy for two hours.
choices.C: The help desk has been busy two hours ago.
choices.D: The help desk is busy for 9 a.m.

questions.translationJa: ヘルプデスクは2時間ずっと忙しい状態です。
questions.explanationJa: two hours は期間の長さなので for が必要です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence using a starting point.

choices.A: The store has offered delivery service for January.
choices.B: The store has offered delivery service January ago.
choices.C: The store offered delivery service since three months.
choices.D: The store has offered delivery service since January.

questions.translationJa: その店は1月から配送サービスを提供しています。
questions.explanationJa: January は起点なので since を使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the grammatically correct sentence about a continuing contract.

choices.A: We have had this maintenance contract for five years.
choices.B: We have been having this maintenance contract since five years.
choices.C: We had this maintenance contract for 2021.
choices.D: We have have this maintenance contract for five years.

questions.translationJa: 当社はこの保守契約を5年間継続しています。
questions.explanationJa: 期間継続は have had ... for five years で表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about an event three days in the past.

choices.A: The carrier has reported the delay three days ago.
choices.B: The carrier has report the delay three days ago.
choices.C: The carrier reported the delay three days ago.
choices.D: The carrier reports the delay since three days.

questions.translationJa: 運送会社は3日前に遅延を報告しました。
questions.explanationJa: ago が完結した過去時点を作るため reported を使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that naturally links a past event to a present result.

choices.A: I misplaced the receipt tomorrow, so I cannot claim it now.
choices.B: I have misplaced the receipt last Monday, so I cannot claim it now.
choices.C: I have been misplace the receipt, so I cannot claim it now.
choices.D: I have misplaced the receipt, so I cannot claim the expense now.

questions.translationJa: 領収書をなくしたため、今その経費を申請できません。
questions.explanationJa: 紛失の結果が今も続くため have misplaced が適切です。
questions.focus: 現在の困り事と結果用法

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with since followed by a clause.

choices.A: The lobby has been quieter for the renovation ended.
choices.B: The lobby has been quieter since the renovation ended.
choices.C: The lobby has been quieter ago the renovation ended.
choices.D: The lobby is quieter since three weeks.

questions.translationJa: 改装が終わってからロビーは以前より静かです。
questions.explanationJa: the renovation ended は開始点を示す節なので since を使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a period of ownership.

choices.A: Ms. Ito has owned the shop for eleven years.
choices.B: Ms. Ito has owned the shop since eleven years.
choices.C: Ms. Ito has been owning the shop for eleven years.
choices.D: Ms. Ito owned the shop eleven years ago and no longer does.

questions.translationJa: 伊藤さんはその店を11年間所有しています。
questions.explanationJa: 所有状態の長さは has owned ... for eleven years です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a current consequence.

choices.A: The entrance flooded next week, so visitors use the side door now.
choices.B: The entrance has flooded yesterday, so visitors use the side door.
choices.C: The entrance has flooded, so visitors must use the side door.
choices.D: The entrance has flood, so visitors must use the side door.

questions.translationJa: 入口が浸水したため、来館者は横の扉を使わなければなりません。
questions.explanationJa: 浸水の結果が現在の動線に影響しているため has flooded が合います。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence contrasting since and ago.

choices.A: We have moved here four years ago and live here for then.
choices.B: We moved here since four years and have lived here ago.
choices.C: We have lived here four years ago since then.
choices.D: We moved here four years ago and have lived here since then.

questions.translationJa: 私たちは4年前にここへ移り、それ以来住んでいます。
questions.explanationJa: ago は過去形 moved、since then は現在完了 have lived と自然に対応します。

questions.prompt: Choose the grammatically correct sentence about continuous availability.

choices.A: The online portal has been available for noon.
choices.B: The online portal has been available since noon.
choices.C: The online portal has available since noon.
choices.D: The online portal was available since two hours.

questions.translationJa: オンライン窓口は正午から利用可能です。
questions.explanationJa: noon は起点なので since、形は has been available です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The clinic began using this system six months ago and still uses it.”

choices.A: The clinic has used this system since six months.
choices.B: The clinic used this system only six months ago.
choices.C: The clinic will use this system for six months ago.
choices.D: The clinic has used this system for six months.

questions.translationJa: その診療所はこのシステムを6か月間使用しています。
questions.explanationJa: 開始から今までの期間を for six months で表しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The parking area closed at noon and remains closed.”

choices.A: The parking area has been closed for noon.
choices.B: The parking area has been closed since noon.
choices.C: The parking area closed three hours tomorrow.
choices.D: The parking area has closed noon ago.

questions.translationJa: 駐車場は正午から閉鎖されたままです。
questions.explanationJa: 正午という起点から今まで続く状態なので since noon が合います。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The network failed, and employees cannot connect now.”

choices.A: The network failed next month, so employees cannot connect now.
choices.B: The network has failed last Friday, so employees cannot connect.
choices.C: The network has failed, so employees cannot connect now.
choices.D: The network will fail, but employees connected yesterday.

questions.translationJa: ネットワークが故障したため、従業員は今接続できません。
questions.explanationJa: 過去の故障が現在の接続不能を生む結果用法です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Our partnership started in 2021 and continues today.”

choices.C: We were partners three years ago only.

questions.translationJa: 私たちは2021年から提携関係にあります。
questions.explanationJa: 2021 は継続の起点なので since 2021 が同義です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The office acquired this copier nine years ago and still owns it.”

choices.A: The office has owned this copier since nine years.
choices.B: The office has owned this copier for nine years.
choices.C: The office owns this copier nine years ago.
choices.D: The office has been owning this copier for 2017.

questions.translationJa: 事務所はこのコピー機を9年間所有しています。
questions.explanationJa: 所有の継続期間は has owned ... for nine years です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The key was lost, and the cabinet cannot be opened now.”

choices.A: Someone lost the key tomorrow, so the cabinet is open now.
choices.B: Someone has lost the key yesterday.
choices.C: Someone will lose the key after the cabinet opens.
choices.D: Someone has lost the key, so the cabinet cannot be opened now.

questions.translationJa: 誰かが鍵をなくしたため、今そのキャビネットを開けられません。
questions.explanationJa: 現在の開錠不能という結果に焦点を置く現在完了です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The manager arrived at 8:00 and is still here.”

choices.A: The manager has been here for 8:00.
choices.C: The manager has been here since 8:00.
choices.D: The manager has arrived here for three hours ago.

questions.translationJa: 部長は8時からずっとここにいます。
questions.explanationJa: 8:00 は開始点なので has been here since 8:00 と言い換えます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The waiting period has lasted two weeks.”

choices.A: We have waited for two weeks.
choices.B: We have waited since two weeks.
choices.C: We waited two weeks ago and stopped.

questions.translationJa: 私たちは2週間待っています。
questions.explanationJa: two weeks は期間なので for を用いた現在完了が同義です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The freezer broke down, so the food is unsafe now.”

choices.A: The freezer broke down next week, so the food was safe.
choices.B: The freezer has broken down, so the food is unsafe now.
choices.C: The freezer has broken down two months ago.
choices.D: The freezer is breaking down yesterday.

questions.translationJa: 冷凍庫が故障したため、食品は今安全ではありません。
questions.explanationJa: 故障という過去の出来事が今の安全性に影響しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The service started when the store opened.”

choices.A: The service has been available for the store opened.
choices.B: The service was available three days ago only.
choices.C: The service has available since opening tomorrow.
choices.D: The service has been available since the store opened.

questions.translationJa: そのサービスは店が開店してから利用できます。
questions.explanationJa: 開始点を表す節には since を使い、現在までの継続を示します。

questions.prompt: The hotel began renovations in May, and the work continues. It has been under renovation ------- May.

choices.C: ago

questions.translationJa: ホテルは5月に改装を始め、工事が続いています。5月から改装中です。
questions.explanationJa: May は工事開始の起点なので since が適切です。

questions.prompt: The support line opened ninety minutes ago and is still busy. It has been busy ------- ninety minutes.

choices.C: for

questions.translationJa: サポート回線は90分前に開き、今も混雑しています。90分間混雑しています。
questions.explanationJa: ninety minutes は継続期間なので for を使います。

questions.prompt: A pipe has burst in the basement. As a result, the elevator is unavailable -------.

choices.C: last week

questions.translationJa: 地下で配管が破裂しました。その結果、エレベーターは今利用できません。
questions.explanationJa: 現在の結果を明示する now が文脈に合います。

questions.prompt: We first hired this cleaning company in 2023. We have used its services ------- then.

choices.C: during

questions.translationJa: 当社は2023年にこの清掃会社を初めて採用し、それ以来サービスを利用しています。
questions.explanationJa: then という起点から今までを示す since then が必要です。

questions.prompt: The warehouse manager bought the scanner eight years ago. The warehouse has owned it ------- eight years.

choices.C: for

questions.translationJa: 倉庫責任者は8年前にスキャナーを購入し、倉庫は8年間所有しています。
questions.explanationJa: eight years は期間なので for を選びます。

questions.prompt: The vendor submitted the wrong invoice yesterday. We ------- it yesterday and requested a replacement.

choices.C: have been noticing

questions.translationJa: 業者は昨日誤った請求書を提出しました。私たちは昨日それに気づき、差し替えを求めました。
questions.explanationJa: yesterday で完結した出来事なので単純過去 noticed が適切です。
questions.focus: 終了した過去と結果用法の区別

questions.prompt: The security gate will not open. Someone has ------- the access code incorrectly too many times.

choices.C: enters

questions.translationJa: セキュリティゲートが開きません。誰かがアクセスコードを何度も誤入力しました。
questions.explanationJa: 現在のロック状態を生んだ完了した行為なので has entered を使います。

questions.prompt: The restaurant has offered online reservations ------- it launched its new website.

choices.C: ago

questions.translationJa: そのレストランは新しいウェブサイトを公開して以来、オンライン予約を提供しています。
questions.explanationJa: 公開した時点を表す節の前には since を置きます。

questions.prompt: The employees began waiting at 7:30. They have been outside ------- nearly an hour.

choices.C: ago

questions.translationJa: 従業員は7時30分に待ち始め、1時間近く外にいます。
questions.explanationJa: nearly an hour は期間の長さなので for が必要です。

questions.prompt: The delivery truck has broken down, so the afternoon shipments ------- delayed now.

choices.C: are

questions.translationJa: 配送トラックが故障したため、午後の出荷は現在遅れています。
questions.explanationJa: 現在の結果で複数主語 shipments なので are delayed が適切です。
